title: Low-evidence triage: 44 products with evidenceCompleteness < 50%
headline_finding: All 44 of 44 low-evidence products trace to a capture-pipeline defect (no capture ever attempted, an ambiguous capture-to-PID join, or a cross-category or parser miss on a real capture) -- not to a source-side absence of nutrition data. 43 of 44 are classified RE-SCRAPABLE (17 high-confidence no_canonical_capture, 24 high-confidence ambiguous_capture_match all concentrated in the cookies_coffee shelf, 2 medium-high-confidence matched_gtin bugs). 1 of 44 (a juice, tiv_taam capture) is RE-SCRAPABLE only at medium confidence and should be spot-checked before re-scrape spend since its 4-of-10-populated pattern could plausibly be a genuinely-sparse label. Zero products in this cohort were classified GENUINELY-MISSING outright -- there is no discard action to take from this triage; the missing-data-discard rule was not invoked because no case showed evidence of an on-source absence.

systemic_bugs_flagged_for_escalation.scope: 24 of 29 low-evidence cookies_coffee products (83 percent) share capture_match_note=ambiguous_capture_match, all resolving to real shufersal captures that the PID join could not confidently attach.
systemic_bugs_flagged_for_escalation.recommendation: Fix the shufersal barcode-to-PID matcher / disambiguation logic once, rather than 24 individual re-scrapes. Escalate to whichever agent owns the capture-join code (pd2 registry-join lane).

systemic_bugs_flagged_for_escalation.scope: bari_99823653f142dcfd663a79cb (milk shelf, cow whole milk) resolves to a capture whose layer_3 assessed category = "bread", with layer_2 source = "unknown" and all 10 fields null despite status = retrieved.
systemic_bugs_flagged_for_escalation.recommendation: Audit the capture-store GTIN index for cross-category collisions; do not let a category-filtered match silently report status=retrieved with null values -- that bookkeeping makes the dossier look more complete than it is. Recommend the compiler mark these not_retrieved rather than retrieved when the underlying capture was category-filtered out.

systemic_bugs_flagged_for_escalation.bug: retailer field null despite resolvable URL domain
systemic_bugs_flagged_for_escalation.scope: 4 products (3 in no_canonical_capture, 1 in matched_gtin_category_filtered) have identity_facts.retailer = null even though source_urls unambiguously resolve to yochananof.
systemic_bugs_flagged_for_escalation.recommendation: Minor identity-derivation completeness gap; not blocking this triage, noted for the retailer-field derivation owner.
